mentions.name: Video Commander
mentions.description: A suite of media inspection and encoding tools based on FFmpeg and VMAF, offering an IDE-like experience for working with video. Built with Rust + Tauri and a React frontend, it includes a /playground area with a WASM build so users can try the inspection tools in the browser before downloading the full version.
